params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the content to be queried for its descendants.

params.name: expand
params.description:
A multi-value parameter indicating which properties of the children to
expand, where:

- `attachment` returns all attachments for the content.
- `comments` returns all comments for the content.
- `page` returns all child pages of the content.

items.docs: This API operation retrieves all descendants of a specified Confluence content item by its ID. Descendants include all child pages, nested subpages, comments, and attachments that exist below the specified content in the content hierarchy tree. The endpoint returns a paginated list of content objects that are hierarchically related to the parent content, allowing developers to traverse and map the complete content structure beneath a given page or blog post. This is particularly useful for opera
